CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Cancer Center

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient: [redacted name]
Age/Sex: 61-year-old female
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Bone marrow aspirate
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Myeloma - cytogenetic assessment requested

TEST REQUESTED
Conventional cytogenetics (G-banded karyotype analysis)

RESULT
No chromosome analysis performed

COMMENT
Per clinical request, FISH studies for myeloma panel were prioritized instead of conventional karyotype analysis. The specimen has been processed for interphase FISH studies only. No metaphase chromosome analysis was performed.

RECOMMENDATION
FISH studies for myeloma panel are in progress and will be reported separately. These targeted studies will assess for common cytogenetic abnormalities associated with plasma cell myeloma including del(13q), del(17p), t(4;14), t(11;14), t(14;16), and hyperdiploidy.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director

clinical_outcome.overall_implications: Conventional karyotype analysis was not performed as FISH studies were prioritized for myeloma assessment
